g.text: Active runtime against licensed operating hours, grouped by owning spoke

text.tspan: Low utilisation is spare capacity for new automations; high utilisation flags a worker at risk of
becoming a bottleneck. Each spoke runs on its own VDIs, so a spoke filter shows the machines it pays for.
